text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back from our outing, Winning Ticket turns to me on the train station platform with a serious look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Let's go on a journey! A trip with no destination!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: For the thrill of adventure! It's not an adventure if you know where you're going!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: We'll set out for the unknown with nothing but a one-way ticket in hand! Isn't that exciting?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You said you'd help me find new, exciting experiences, right? I want us to do this together, just the two of us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like Winning Ticket is still on her quest for inspiration. First "Romance of the Three Kingdoms," then futsal, and now a journey into the unknown?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If that's what she's set her heart on, I'll follow wherever it takes us.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoa, this train is so awesome! It shakes so much!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wooow, what a cool bus! It mercilessly ignores any bus stop without people!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: From here, we walk! Wooow, amazing! We can travel without paying any money!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wait, Trainer! How are we gonna get back? I really did only buy a one-way ticket, you know!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah… you're right! I can't be worrying about what happens next!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have money for the return journey, but let's not mention that right now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a long trek, we arrive at…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoa… I really have no idea where we are!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm so blown away! This is it, Trainer! This is what travel is all about!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, but…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It's kind of amazing. There's nothing here. No races, no academy…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: And yet, I'm alive! Trainer, you too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: We can live, even without a purpose in life! Even without races!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Th-that's a little scary, but wow! This sure is a real journey.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taken aback by the unfamiliar setting, Ticket's imagination runs wild. It seems like the new experience is expanding her mind.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hey, listen… I've only got a tiny bit of money left.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: If I buy one last ticket, we'll be left stranded in that place. So in that case…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Where do you think we should head? What should our final destination be?
choice_data_list: Let's go as far as we possibly can.
Wherever you want to go the most.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: As far as we can…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I've come this far, so I can't stop now! ALL RIIIGHT!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So we forge blindly onward without stopping to think where we're heading. Until finally, we arrive at…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay! It's the beach! We really did go as far as we possibly could!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You were right! There's no point being afraid—we've just gotta push on as far as we can!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Woo-hooooo! I'm awesome! And now…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Farewell, everyone back home! Sniffle… I hope you'll never forget meeeee!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She came all this way, really believing she'd never see her friends again.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: This is fine! I'll settle down here and fish for tuna the rest of my life!
choice_data_list: No, let's go back. By taxi.
No, let's go back. By taxi.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take my wallet out and show her the contents.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whaaaat?! How come you have that?! I thought we were setting out with nothing but a one-way ticket!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sob… Thank youuu! I'll pay you back, little by little!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tears of joy run down her face. But it seems her journey of no return has given her courage.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Somewhere unknown? Good point… We might've come a long way, but at the end of the day, we're still just somewhere in Japan…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Let's do iiiit! We gotta find somewhere way more mysterious! Somewhere completely out there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Forging wildly onward, we somehow arrive at…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah, I think we've done it! This place is completely out there!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I can see the earth up there in the sky! And is it just me, or is the air here reeeeally thin?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: My body feels really light, Trainer! Look! Boing, boing!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I've gotta try running like this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishin, Taishiiin! Listen to this! It's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I went to the moon yesterday! I mean, wooow! I was a racer in space!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Um, what?
choice_data_list: She fell asleep in the taxi home.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …Makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps because of her own fantasies, it looks like Winning Ticket is running a little faster.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Where I want to go the most… Yeah, you're right…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: If I'll be stuck there, it has to be somewhere I really want to go…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We go as far as we can by train, and then, after a lot more walking, we arrive at…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: We're here… Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The place where the Derby is held. 'Cause, you know, this is my…
choice_data_list: This place has always been your goal.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! This is the only spot for me!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ever since that day when I was inspired by the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: In my heart, I bought a one-way ticket to this place a long time ago.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Nothing's changed. I still want to be here! Even if I could never leave, it'd be totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's what I learned from this adventure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Going on a journey means to reaffirm where you belong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That seems to apply especially to Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this is where our trip ends, but…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Let's continue our journey together—to come here over and over again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even when the Derby is over, there are many other important races for her to run in here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her determination renewed, Winning Ticket seems to be brimming with more power than ever.
